scope_exclusions: Protocol, amendment and prompt files; original and v2 content endpoints to prevent self-inclusion. Other current working text artifacts, including preserved snapshots and reports, are additionally scanned.
category_reference: R01–R13 refer in order to the 13 vocabulary entries in check 6 of CODEX-PROMPT-4.md. R14 is the numeric-unit pattern, R15 an excluded populated data field, and R16 a sampled 13-word source-window match. No hit text is reproduced.
copy_sampling: Uniform without replacement across available 13-word windows, after choosing the preferred held text version for each source page. Case and punctuation are normalised. Common bibliographic phrases are retained as hits.
limitation: This sampled window check cannot prove absence of longer copied passages outside its sampled windows.
classification_rule: Every raw coordinate is retained. Pure numeric windows are numeric-table coincidences. The remaining window matches equal a registered publication title and are bibliographic identity citations. Safety vocabulary is recorded separately. No hit text is reproduced.
